ValidationRule.description: The only backward move allowed is QA / Review back to Implementation (QA failed). Everything else moves forward.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Permission.Bypass_Onboarding_Automation), NOT(ISNEW()), ISCHANGED(Stage__c), Stage_Number__c < CASE(TEXT(PRIORVALUE(Stage__c)), "Kickoff_Scheduled", 1, "Gathering_Info", 2, "Implementation", 3, "QA_Review", 4, "Go_Live", 5, "Post_Launch_Review", 6, 0), NOT(AND( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Stage__c), "QA_Review"), ISPICKVAL(Stage__c, "Implementation") )) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Onboardings can only move back from QA / Review to Implementation.
